task.name: dual_block_select_place
task.instruction_template: Put the {color} block into the {color} tray.

instruction_values.red: Put the red block into the red tray.
instruction_values.blue: Put the blue block into the blue tray.

task.target: the instructed colour; placed into its same-colour tray
task.distractor: the other colour; never grasped and never moved by the expert
task.source: external dual-SO101 MuJoCo project, scripted physical expert through this branch adapter

record_conflicts.source: model-line prototype experiment_state.json (ignored; not tracked here)
recorded_instructions: Place the red block in the tray.
Place the blue block in the tray.
record_conflicts.recorded_tray_rule: one tray, position random; the recorded text does not bind tray colour to target colour
record_conflicts.this_branch: two coloured trays; target goes into the same-colour tray; instructions name the tray colour
record_conflicts.resolution: the later confirmed rule in this protocol governs scene2 data; the model-line prototype file is ignored and was not modified

source_binding.snapshot_policy: independent ignored snapshot under the cache root; the shared checkout, the scene1 snapshot and other workstreams' files are never modified
source_binding.provenance_note: the scene1 protocol records source_sha256 201898ff... with 109 files; the current shared snapshot measured here has 113 files and 908d940d... The difference is not silently adopted: this branch pins and records the tree it actually executes.; v4 reuses the same source and the v1 expert/slots on a narrowed feasible family

grasp.basis: v1 reference expert; no v2/v3 release/withdraw keys in this profile

pre_pilot_engineering_scan.v3_result: 3/8; per-scene search partial; fixed 60 mm lift unreachable in two layouts
pre_pilot_engineering_scan.v4_decision: narrow the family to the v1/v3 success region and re-run the v1 reference expert on 12 layouts x 2 = 24 episodes
pre_pilot_engineering_scan.v4_preliminary: one v4 episode (layout0 red) ran with positive y lower 0.235 m and failed arm_not_clear because the parked left home TCP was over the red tray; the positive lower was corrected to 0.263 m and a parked-arm-tray clearance check was added; the preliminary episode is excluded from the 24-episode pilot

state.timing: measured joint state immediately before the action is issued

action.semantics: absolute joint-position target, left six then right six
action.label_rule: the clamped actuator target actually applied at that control frame; never the next measured state
action.chunk_horizon: left to the model line; no chunk length is frozen by this protocol

arrangements.rule: the red tray occupies one side and the blue tray the other; the arrangement is sampled independently of the instruction
arrangements.balance: formal collection must split evenly; the 4-scene pilot uses 2 of each

constraints: tray footprint inside the table by at least 0.02 m
tray-tray outer-edge gap at least 0.03 m
each block outside both tray keepouts plus 0.01 m
chosen slot release, hover, descent and withdrawal IK and collision screening
trays.slot_rule: v1 external two-slot rule (slot_0 then slot_1)

blocks.target_xy_source: certified pick points of the arm on the target tray's side; jitter 0.004 m
blocks.distractor_xy_source: certified pick points of the arm on the other tray's side; jitter 0.004 m

yaw.domain_basis: v1/v3 successes span 33.5-66.5 deg; v1/v3 high-yaw failures at 67.45-73.49 deg; narrowed to [33,67] with the unchanged predicate

per_scene_checks: target grasp IK and hover IK at the sampled yaw
target approach and lift path screening with the distractor present and the other arm parked
target place release and hover IK at the sampled yaw
target descent and withdrawal screening with the distractor present
containment of the rotated cube footprint in the same-colour tray
initial settling: no robot contact with either block, no block-block contact, speeds below limits
block centre at least 0.105 m from each tray outer rectangle

colour_decoupling.rule: the instruction colour and the tray arrangement are sampled independently; the active arm is the arm on the target tray's side
colour_decoupling.consequence: across scenes each colour is executed by both arms and placed on both table sides; no colour is bound to one arm or one position
colour_decoupling.within_scene: the two counterfactual instructions of one layout necessarily use different arms because the trays are on opposite sides

active_arm_rule.selection: left if the target tray centre has y > 0, right if y < 0
active_arm_rule.other_arm: home park pose [0, -25, 40, -15, 0] degrees, gripper 40 percent; certified park; no handover and no second-arm motion
active_arm_rule.safety: the parked TCP is about 0.22 m above the table surface; initial settling and the success predicate both check no robot-block or robot-tray contact

scene_layout.duplicate_scene_policy: a layout SHA-256 may appear once; the two target conditions of one layout are a registered counterfactual pair, not duplicates

family_basis.note: the ranges keep all 7 v1/v3 successes and reject all 9 v1/v3 failures in the recorded layouts; the v4 24-episode independent-seed pilot is the generalisation test, not formal validation
family_basis.positive_y_lower_basis: preliminary v4 episode layout0 red had the red tray at y=0.247 m; the parked left home TCP (y=0.190 m) was inside the tray outer rectangle and the success predicate returned arm_not_clear. All v1/v3 positive-tray successes have y>=0.2641 m; v4 positive y is narrowed to [0.263,0.274].

requires_all_target: the target block is inside its same-colour tray using the rotated footprint against the tray inner half-size
the target block is supported by that tray's floor geom ({colour}_tray_0)
no contact between the target block and either arm (released)
target linear speed <= 0.02 m/s and angular speed <= 0.2 rad/s
both arms are at the registered home park pose within 2.0 degrees and 5.0 gripper percent
no contact between either arm and either tray
both TCP sites are at least 0.01 m from the target block centre and from the outer rectangle of both trays
all of the above hold continuously for at least 0.5 s
requires_all_distractor: no contact between the distractor block and either arm
no bilateral gripper grasp of the distractor by either arm
distractor supported by the table (or a tray floor, never outside the table)
distractor linear speed <= 0.02 m/s and angular speed <= 0.2 rad/s
distractor displacement from its post-settle initial pose <= the registered baseline threshold
distractor checks hold over the same 0.5 s success window

distractor_baseline.method: 12 independent layouts from the same sampler, both arms parked at home, 0.4 s settle then 2.0 s hold; post-settle displacement, speed, robot contact and false grasp measured every physics step
distractor_baseline.threshold_rule: max(0.002, measured_max + 0.001); the 2 mm floor governs because the measured drift is below 1 mm
distractor_baseline.scope_note: the baseline has no arm motion; arm-induced table vibration is not included and is reported in the physical pilot
distractor_baseline.record: tracked summary in experiments/so101/scene2-dual-random-baseline.json; full record in the ignored run directory
distractor_baseline.v4_recheck: 12-scene v4 baseline uses the same 2 mm threshold; measured value in the tracked v4 baseline summary

not_sufficient: target tray state alone without the distractor checks
a single frame of support or containment

scene_family.definition: family_key = layout_sha256 over both blocks (names, colours, XY, yaw), both tray poses, arrangement, seed, model and certificate hashes
scene_family.rule: the red-target and blue-target episodes of one layout are a counterfactual pair and never cross train/validation
scene_family.split_algorithm: to be registered with the formal collection; whole layout families only
scene_family.frozen_before: any normalisation statistic or training update

seed_registry.pilot_policy: a pilot layout is never reused as a demonstration; every candidate and every executed episode is recorded

layout_pilot.acceptance_gate: at least 0.50 of attempted seeds produce a fully checked layout with both target conditions feasible; otherwise narrow the yaw or tray domain, record the amendment and rerun
layout_pilot.record: per-seed tray poses, both block XY/yaw, per-target IK and collision verdicts, initial-settling metrics, sampler draws and rejection reasons

physical_pilot.rule: each of the 12 layouts is executed once with the red instruction and once with the blue instruction; no episode retry after a physical failure
physical_pilot.success_gate: report the exact count out of 24; if below 20/24, report the shortfall and do not register a formal collection; never relax a check
physical_pilot.initial_state_fingerprint: the two conditions must reproduce the same post-settle state fingerprint; a mismatch invalidates the pair

formal.normalisation: not computed in this phase; only frozen-split train data may supply it

data_interface.raw_control_tick: one row per control frame at 50 Hz; 10 physics substeps per row when complete
data_interface.timestamps: simulation time from the environment; wall-clock start/end per episode; no synthetic index is treated as proof of no dropped frames
data_interface.three_cameras: central, left_wrist, right_wrist at 640x480 RGB, captured before the action is applied
data_interface.state_action_order: left six then right six; degrees for joints and percent for grippers
data_interface.action_label: clamped absolute target actually applied that frame
data_interface.objects: both blocks: position, quaternion, linear and angular velocity per control frame
data_interface.events: stage start/end, contact-monitor facts, failures, initial/final state
data_interface.chunk_length: model line decides; this branch supplies contiguous raw trajectories
data_interface.pilot_dataset: if written, labelled pilot_only and excluded from training and validation

claims.engineering_chain: narrowed feasible family from v1/v3 successes; v1 reference expert and two-slot rule; 12 layouts x 2 instructions = 24 condition episodes; not formal validation
explicitly_not: a formal training or validation split

pilot_amendments.change: the first baseline attempt consumed seeds 21000-21004 inside the original evaluation reservation; that run was discarded, the clean baseline used 20800-20899, and evaluation is reserved on 21100-21199
pilot_amendments.effect: no pilot or training data used the superseded seeds; the threshold comes only from the clean run

pilot_amendments.change: engineering scan set open_percent=70 and candidate yaw [30,75], and admitted target CAD-band contact only in the grasp descend
pilot_amendments.effect: registered before the layout pilot; the layout pilot still measures the accepted distribution and the physical pilot judges success with the unchanged predicate

pilot_amendments.change: narrow yaw to [33,67], tray x to [0.214,0.270], |tray y| to [0.235,0.274], and block-tray outer clearance to 0.105 m; use the v1 reference expert/slots
pilot_amendments.effect: new v4 family and 24-episode pilot; v1/v2/v3 evidence unchanged; success predicate and 0.5 mm guard unchanged

pilot_amendments.change: positive tray y lower raised from 0.235 to 0.263 m and a parked-arm-tray initial clearance check added
pilot_amendments.effect: one preliminary episode excluded; corrected 24-episode pilot; predicate/guard unchanged
